page.layout: One printed page. Main text in one column, centre-left. Right margin: one marginal note beside line 3 (reference "Psal. 15. 1.4;"). Left margin: fragments of notes, cut off by the scan edge and not legible. Running head at top left, page number at top right. Below the text: signature "D" at left and catchword "itarum" at right.

main_text.p: ōmnis simulatio a parte ante, ipso sc.[?] tempore, & inter ipsum actum jurandi. In altero, consimili quæstioni, Quis ha-{s}bitabit in tabernaculo Domini, &c. inter alia respondetur non multùm dissimiliter, Qui juravit in malum, (למרמה[?]) & non mutavit; id est, qui postquam se juramento obligavit, maluit vel cum magno suo damno præstare quod incommodè juravit, quàm alicujus temporalis commodi intuitu datam fidem violare: ubi excluditur omnis simulatio a parte post: Ista mihi aut non cogitare [?]identur, aut non ferio, eorum qui nunc int hominum pleraque pars: qui in [?]mne illud quodcunque demum fuerit, quod est ab his quibus nocendi potestas [?]t propositum, sine ulla ambage proli-& conceptis verbis jurare non ve-[?]ntur: quin sibi potiùs soli sapere vi-[?]entur, ridentque non sine aliquo fastu [?]rum simplicitatem & inanem metum, ut ne conscientiam lædant, nodum in scirpo quærunt scilicet, & perscriptas ab qui proscribere possunt formulas sol-[?]icant. Securi interim se ab omni per-[?]rii crimine metuque liberant, sibique conscientiæ suæ egregiè consultum e-limant, si vel inter jurandum, Jesu-Psal. 15.[?] 1.4;

page.notes: Left margin: several marginal notes are cut off by the scan edge and cannot be read; they are not transcribed. Doubtful readings marked [?]: the first word of the page (fragment at scan edge, "ipso sc."), the Hebrew in parentheses (copied as seen), the opening letters of several words clipped at the left edge, and the note numbers "15." and "1.4". The in-text mark "s" is placed after "ha-" as it appears beside that line. Printed errors left as printed: "dissimiliter" and similar spellings as seen. Long s is normalised to s throughout; i/j and u/v adjusted to the rules.
